name: Sun Cleric: Sun Stride streams cleared cooldown-on-event flags and sends SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN on cast (#13645)
contract: Older and non-Descension client Spell.dbc builds carry SPELL_ATTR0_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT (0x02000000) on Sun Stride 680700 (Attributes 0x2000010, AttributesEx 0x10088000, AttributesEx5 0x8). SpellInfoCorrections clears SPELL_ATTR0_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT on the server so the 24 s cooldown starts on cast, but 680700 was neither registered in ClientSpellPatches (SMSG_PATCH_SPELL 2346) nor pushed via SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN on cast. Clients whose Spell.dbc still carried the flag therefore locked Sun Stride in a pending-event state with no timer until a map change resynced spells. Registering 680700 in ClientSpellPatches streams its server Attributes (16), AttributesEx (32768), and AttributesEx5 (0) at login, and OnSpellCast pushes a native SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN matching Player::GetSpellCooldownDelay(680700) (24000 ms base, 20000 ms with Leap of the Valkyrie 301295) while preserving the solar trail rider 681434 and recast lockout.
